assertions.sql: SELECT c.name, p.name AS produkt, o.quantity FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.quantity >= 2 ORDER BY c.name, p.name

SELECT c.name AS kunde, p.name AS produkt, (o.quantity * p.price) AS linje_total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE c.city = 'Aarhus' ORDER BY linje_total DESC, kunde
